note: The page to read before any decision is made. Things we can prove, things we cannot, and the specific step that turns one into the other. Each row names an owner, because a question with no owner is a wish.

known.statement: The Associates tracking ID supplied with this brief is shopnow047c-20.
Amazon's Operating Agreement §5 requires the exact statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' to appear clearly and prominently on the site.

Participation Requirements 2(b) requires the Associates ID as a URL parameter in every link to an Amazon site, and requires Special Links to be accessed directly from the site rather than through a redirect.
A site may show price and availability only when Amazon serves that data or it arrives through the Creators or PA API, and may not republish customer reviews or star ratings without API-sourced data.
Google asks that paid and affiliate links be marked rel="sponsored".
The FTC's own example disclosure for affiliate links is 'I get commissions for purchases made through links in this post', and it should sit close to the recommendation.
A qualifying session lasts 24 hours from the click, or up to 89 days if the item is added to the cart first; purchases are disqualified when links are not properly formatted.
An ASIN is a 10-character alphanumeric code and appears after /dp/ in a product URL, per Amazon's own explanation.
All five supplied link tokens are 9 characters, and every observed product page carries a 10-character identifier.
On 2026-11-20, three of the five supplied links resolved to a product page and two resolved to the Amazon homepage; earlier the same day, those two resolved to product pages.
Four of the five products have a manufacturer specification page published by the brand, and the fifth — the ThermoMaven — has one too, located this pass by matching the listing's model number HT07.
The USDA publishes safe minimum internal temperatures for meat, poultry, fish, eggs, leftovers and casseroles, and expects consumer thermometers to be accurate within 2 to 4 °F.

unknown.question: Which product did the owner intend each of the five supplied links to reach?
unknown.why: Until this is answered, no row can say 'this is the product you submitted'. The site can only say 'this is where the link landed on this date', which is a different claim and a weaker one.
unknown.how: Open each link in a signed-in browser and name the product, or supply the campaign brief and the link-generation record. One message closes it.

unknown.question: Does a tagged buy link on this site actually credit a sale to shopnow047c-20?
unknown.why: This is the only question that decides whether the publication earns anything. Matching the formatting rule is not the same as appearing in a tracking report.
unknown.how: In Associates Central, click one link per product, confirm the destination, and confirm the click appears in the tracking report. That is gate G-02.

unknown.question: Is the Associates account active, and is this site declared in it?
unknown.why: Associates tags must be embedded in links on the sites declared in the application. An account that has not declared the site, or has gone dormant, will not pay out however good the pages are.
unknown.how: Check account status and the declared-sites list in Associates Central.

unknown.question: Where will the analytics collector run, and who may read the data?
unknown.why: GitHub Pages is static, so it cannot run the collector. Without an endpoint there is no measurement, and without measurement the next topic is chosen on instinct.
unknown.how: Pick a host that runs Node or Python, deploy the collector, set the endpoint, and run ten known test clicks before trusting a number.

unknown.question: Which marketplace is intended?
unknown.why: Each marketplace has its own catalogue and its own Associates ID. The -20 tracking ID and the amazon.com pages point to the US programme, but that is an inference, not a statement from the owner.
unknown.how: Confirm the US marketplace and the amazon.com storefront.

unknown.question: Who is the named editor?
unknown.why: A named person with a contact route is a stronger trust signal for readers and crawlers than a desk name. Inventing one would be worse than not having one.
unknown.how: Supply the name, role and contact route of the person who answers for corrections.

unknown.question: What publishing cadence can actually be sustained?
unknown.why: The feed and the sitemap only grow if guides keep shipping. A cadence nobody can hold is worse than a slower one that holds.
unknown.how: Choose an option on the suggestions page and attach a first date.

unknown.question: Should prices ever be displayed, and through which authorised source?
unknown.why: Displaying price requires Amazon-served data or the Creators API, and creates a maintenance obligation, since a stale price is a misleading claim.
unknown.how: Decide whether to enrol in the Creators API. Until then, no price appears anywhere.

unknown.question: What belongs in the campaign ledger, and who exports it?
unknown.why: The ledger stays empty until there is an authorised first-party report to put in it. Importing scraped or estimated numbers would poison every decision made from it.
unknown.how: Export an Associates report, supply it with its date range and provenance, and add one row per campaign window.

unknown.question: Which of the repository's several publications should become the one canonical site?
unknown.why: Several independently generated editions cover the same five links. They agree today because sessions keep checking by hand, which is not a mechanism.
unknown.how: Choose one, write the redirect map, and retire the rest into the archive.

unknown.question: Does the click counter need a privacy notice?
unknown.why: The counter stores no cookies, no IP address and no identifiers, which keeps it small. Whether that is sufficient is a question for the owner's counsel, not a conclusion a build should state.
unknown.how: Obtain a review, or leave the counter off until it is reviewed.

unknown.question: Who owns the Search Console property, and when will the sitemap be submitted?
unknown.why: Without it, no query data exists and nobody can see which guides are being found.
unknown.how: Verify the URL-prefix property, submit /counter-desk/sitemap.xml, and review Performance after two weeks.

unknown.question: Should readers be able to subscribe by email?
unknown.why: Capture needs a provider, a privacy notice and a consent record. Asking for an address before there is anything to send teaches the first readers to ignore the next email.
unknown.how: Choose A, B or C on suggestion SG-30.

unknown.question: What is the reader, precisely?
unknown.why: A site for 'people buying kitchen gear' is not a site. A site for 'renters with sixteen inches of counter cooking for two to four' produces different pages than 'families of six with a big kitchen'.
unknown.how: Nominate one reader and one situation; every guide gets easier to write.

discovery.method: Open each supplied link in a signed-in browser, twice, and record the product name and the 10-character ASIN from the URL.
Generate one Special Link per product in Associates Central, click it, and confirm it appears in the tracking report.
Export the account's tracking-ID list and declared-site list, and keep the export with its date.
Run the collector against ten known test clicks before trusting any figure it produces.
Verify the site in Search Console, submit the sitemap, and read the Performance report after two weeks.
Write down the last five meals actually cooked in the household and match guides to that list instead of to guesses about search volume.
Read the manual PDF linked from the product page for every field the page omits, such as interior dimensions and dishwasher guidance.
Email manufacturer support for each value that two official pages state differently, and keep the reply with its date.
